postName: Good Weekend editorial — the morning run (feed cut, clay levers)

tokens.headline: The morning run: how a bunch leaves the studio
tokens.dek: From first cut to the courier's tray — the hours you don't see.

tokens.quote: We tie the stems before the morning is half done.
tokens.name: Kellie

tokens.text:
The buckets are filled before sunrise.

By eight the bench is a field of cut stems, and the first orders are already wrapped, named and waiting by the door.

By the time the vans leave the studio, every bunch has been cut, conditioned and photographed — a small record of the morning it was made. The photo lands in your inbox before the flowers land at the door.
